entities.summary: Daniel Joseph Meagher is an Australian Catholic bishop. He is the Bishop elect of Rockhampton. He served as an Auxiliary Bishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Sydney from 2021 to 2026. Previously parish priest of All Hallows’ Parish in Five Dock, his episcopal consecration took place on 8 December 2021.
